siteText.heroTitle: Welcome to BAF Shaheen College Kurmitola IT Club
siteText.heroSubtitle: A student-driven club where curiosity, creativity, and technology come together through learning, sharing, and real community.
siteText.aboutHeading:
More Than a Club.
A Learning Community.
siteText.aboutTextOne: BAF Shaheen College Kurmitola IT Club is a place for students who want to explore technology, develop practical skills, and grow through teamwork.
siteText.aboutTextTwo: Since 2016, the club has created opportunities for workshops, talks, competitions, and collaboration that help members become confident and capable learners.
siteText.ctaTitle: Join BAF Shaheen College Kurmitola IT Club Today
siteText.ctaText: Applications are open. Be part of a community that learns, shares, and grows together.
siteText.footerSummary: Building the next generation of tech leaders through learning, teamwork, and creativity.

events.title: AI in Industry
events.description: A talk session on how artificial intelligence is changing real industries and opening new opportunities for learners.
events.details: A focused session exploring the real-world impact of artificial intelligence, current trends in different industries, and how students can prepare for the future of AI-enabled careers.
